She whispers nervously, “I will”  
As he gets on one knee in Ireland  
Hands are shaking, time stands still  
Two lives changing in that moment  

I stand before you today with an open heart and steady hands.  
From Irish blood, German roots, and a Los Angeles boyhood,  
I bring you my whole heart.  

[Build – Story into Vows]  
Today I choose you — my love, my partner, my home.  
With Irish fire in my soul, German strength in my bones,  
and the golden light of California in my heart,  
I promise to love you fiercely and faithfully.  

I promise to love you even when you steal the covers,  
to support your dreams even when they sound mad,  
and to stand by your side whether the waves are calm  
or the traffic is endless.  

I vow to be your safe harbour in every storm,  
your loudest cheer in every triumph,  
and your gentlest critic when needed.  

I will walk beside you through every season of life,  
laugh with you in the light,  
and carry you when the road grows steep.  

May our home be filled with Irish music and laughter,  
built with German resilience and honesty,
